meta.title: Arietta in J
meta.author: after Beethoven, Op. 111
meta.description: A jazz ballad on the Arietta of Beethoven's last piano sonata (Op. 111, 1822): the theme, piano and bass solos, a sax variation in the spirit of Beethoven's own, and the theme again. Tenor sax, piano, double bass and brushes. A demo of the Rosaclef studio.
